name: EPIC 204976331

text.card: A red giant 4,682 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.89 solar masses and 16.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,304 K at its surface.
